styles.icon: Minimalist flat vector UI icon. Clean geometric shapes with rounded corners and one uniform stroke width. Single solid color #3A3A40 (dark graphite) only: no other colors, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no outlines of a different color. No text, no letters, no numbers. The icon is centered and occupies about 70% of the canvas. Perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole image, with nothing else on it. Square 1:1.
styles.upgrade: Minimalist flat vector icon for an upgrade card in a mobile puzzle game. Clean geometric shapes with rounded corners and one uniform stroke width. Exactly two colors: dark graphite #3A3A40 for the main shape and the accent color named below for one highlighted part. No gradients, no shadows, no texture. No text, no letters, no numbers. The icon is centered and occupies about 70% of the canvas. Perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole image, with nothing else on it. Square 1:1.
styles.app_icon: Mobile game app icon. Minimalist flat vector illustration made of simple geometric shapes, top-down view. Soft pastel palette only: ground #F4EFE6, roads #7C7C84, water #9CCBE8, buildings #8E5B3A and #4D8FD1. No gradients, no shadows, no text, no letters. Bold and readable at very small sizes, few large shapes. The illustration fills the whole square canvas edge to edge: no border, no rounded frame, no margin. Square 1:1.
styles.icon_layer: Foreground layer of an Android adaptive app icon. Minimalist flat vector illustration made of simple geometric shapes, top-down view. Colors: roads #7C7C84, water #9CCBE8, buildings #8E5B3A and #4D8FD1. No gradients, no shadows, no text, no letters. All shapes stay inside the central 60% of the canvas. Perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole image, with nothing else on it. Square 1:1.
styles.emblem: Minimalist flat vector emblem for the main menu of a mobile puzzle game about building roads. Simple geometric shapes, top-down view. Soft pastel palette: roads #7C7C84, buildings #8E5B3A, #4D8FD1 and #F2B33D, trees #8CC084. No gradients, no shadows, no text, no letters. Centered, occupies about 80% of the canvas. Perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF background filling the whole image, with nothing else on it. Square 1:1.
styles.banner: Wide promotional banner for a mobile puzzle game about building roads in a growing city. Minimalist flat vector illustration, top-down view, simple geometric shapes. Soft pastel palette: ground #F4EFE6, roads #7C7C84, water #9CCBE8, buildings #8E5B3A, #4D8FD1, #F2B33D, #4FB286, trees #8CC084. No gradients, no shadows, no text, no letters. Wide landscape format, aspect ratio about 2:1.
